host.note: The load line is the LOAD line the script printed at the start of the frozen run (run 3 of spike (b);  runs 1 and 2 used a fixed-cost shape of one empty tcc -c, replaced before freezing).  uptime after the run printed load averages 75.12 66.25 56.74. A denominator that differs from the panel figure is information and not a blocker (brief section 6).

tcc_raw_ms_per_kloc.method: One timed command: rm -rf WORK/out && mkdir -p WORK/out, then tcc -c -o WORK/out/NAME.o corpus/twin/NAME.c for spine, sort, parser and interp in sequence (four tcc invocations).  Every timed run starts from a fresh output directory.  value = median_ms / (lines / 1000).

tcc_corrected_ms_per_kloc.method: The raw row minus the fixed process cost of tcc -c.  The fixed cost is the median of the SAME command shape with every source replaced by one empty translation unit: rm -rf WORK/out && mkdir -p WORK/out, then four times tcc -c -o WORK/out/empty-NAME.o WORK/empty.c on a zero-byte file, measured with the same timer and RUNS in the same run.  median_ms, min_ms and max_ms of the raw row each subtract that one constant.  The empty run printed median_ms=318.591 min_ms=182.933 max_ms=377.427, so the constant is 318.591 ms.  value = median_ms / (lines / 1000).
